blocks.zh: 生物反應性試驗（體外法）完整教學版
blocks.en: Biological Reactivity Tests (In Vitro): Complete Training Edition

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 USP 〈87〉 體外生物反應性試驗的目的與適用範圍，以及三種試驗方法的選擇原則
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and scope of the USP <87> in vitro biological reactivity tests, and the principles for choosing among the three test methods

blocks.zh: 掌握 L-929 細胞培養準備、陽性/陰性對照品設置的具體要求
blocks.en: Master the specific requirements for L-929 cell culture preparation and for setting up positive and negative controls

blocks.zh: 熟悉瓊脂擴散試驗 (Agar Diffusion Test)、直接接觸試驗 (Direct Contact Test)、溶出試驗 (Elution Test) 的操作程序差異
blocks.en: Know how the procedures differ for the Agar Diffusion Test, the Direct Contact Test and the Elution Test

blocks.zh: 能夠正確判讀反應性評級表（Grade 0–4），知道合格標準為 Grade ≤ 2
blocks.en: Read the reactivity grading table correctly (Grade 0–4) and know that the acceptance criterion is Grade ≤ 2

blocks.zh: 了解萃取溶劑選擇邏輯及儀器設備要求（高壓滅菌鍋、烤箱、培養箱）
blocks.en: Understand the logic behind extraction solvent selection and the equipment requirements (autoclave, oven, incubator)

blocks.zh: 連結 USP 〈87〉 與 USP 〈88〉 的關係：體外試驗不合格者需進行體內試驗
blocks.en: Link USP <87> to USP <88>: materials that fail the in vitro tests must go on to in vivo testing

blocks.zh: 理解在 CDMO 製藥生產中，容器密封系統材料合規評估的業務意義
blocks.en: Understand the business significance of material compliance assessment for container closure systems in CDMO pharmaceutical manufacturing

blocks.zh: 第一節：總則與適用範圍 Introduction & Scope
blocks.en: Section 1: Introduction & Scope

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Biological Reactivity Test (生物反應性試驗): 評估彈性體、塑膠等高分子材料與人體細胞接觸後，是否會引起細胞毒性（cytotoxicity）的一系列試驗。這是容器密封系統 (Container Closure System, CCS) 生物相容性評估的核心試驗。
blocks.en: Biological Reactivity Test: A series of tests that evaluate whether elastomers, plastics and other polymeric materials cause cytotoxicity when in contact with human cells. It is the core test in the biocompatibility assessment of a container closure system (CCS).

blocks.zh: 三種試驗方法選擇邏輯：
blocks.en: Logic for choosing among the three test methods:

blocks.zh: 瓊脂擴散試驗：適用於各種形狀的彈性體密封件
blocks.en: Agar Diffusion Test: suitable for elastomeric closures of any shape

blocks.zh: 直接接觸試驗：適用於中密度材料，可同步萃取與測試
blocks.en: Direct Contact Test: suitable for materials of medium density; extraction and testing take place at the same time

blocks.zh: 溶出試驗：適用於高密度材料及劑量反應評估
blocks.en: Elution Test: suitable for high-density materials and for dose-response evaluation

blocks.zh: 表面積換算原則：無法測定表面積時 → 彈性體 0.1 g/mL；塑膠 0.2 g/mL 萃取液
blocks.en: Surface area conversion rule: where the surface area cannot be determined → elastomers 0.1 g/mL; plastics 0.2 g/mL of extractant

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你要測試一個新橡膠塞是否「安全」。你不能直接把它放進人體測試，所以先讓它和「培養皿裡的人類細胞」接觸——觀察細胞的反應。如果細胞沒死、形態正常，代表材料生物相容性良好；如果細胞大量死亡，則需要進一步的動物試驗（USP 〈88〉）。這就是「體外（In Vitro）→ 體內（In Vivo）」的分級評估邏輯。
blocks.en: Imagine you want to test whether a new rubber stopper is "safe". You cannot put it into a human body to find out, so you first bring it into contact with "human cells in a culture dish" and watch how the cells react. If the cells survive and their morphology stays normal, the material is biocompatible; if many cells die, further animal testing (USP <88>) is needed. This is the tiered "in vitro → in vivo" evaluation logic.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 〈87〉 與 〈88〉 的關係： USP 〈87〉 是第一道篩選關卡（體外）；若不合格，材料必須接受 USP 〈88〉 動物試驗（體內）。合規策略是先通過 〈87〉，避免進入 〈88〉 動物試驗——這在法規與倫理上都更有效率。
blocks.en: Relationship between <87> and <88>: USP <87> is the first screening gate (in vitro); a material that fails must undergo the USP <88> animal tests (in vivo). The compliance strategy is to pass <87> first and so avoid the <88> animal tests, which is more efficient both from the regulatory and the ethical point of view.

blocks.zh: 適用材料範圍： 直接或間接接觸患者的彈性體（如橡膠塞、隔膜）、塑膠（如注射器、IV袋）及其他高分子材料。
blocks.en: Materials covered: elastomers that contact the patient directly or indirectly (such as rubber stoppers and diaphragms), plastics (such as syringes and IV bags) and other polymeric materials.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個 PFS（預充式注射器）的活塞頭無法精確測量表面積，應用多少克/mL 的萃取比例？
blocks.en: The plunger tip of a PFS (prefilled syringe) cannot have its surface area measured accurately. What extraction ratio (g/mL) should be used?

blocks.zh: 如果溶出試驗結果顯示 Grade 3（Moderate），下一步應怎麼做？
blocks.en: If an Elution Test result shows Grade 3 (Moderate), what should be done next?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 〈87〉 只能篩查生物毒性，而無法完全代替 USP 〈88〉？
blocks.en: Why can USP <87> only screen for biological toxicity and not fully replace USP <88>?

blocks.zh: 第二節：試驗對照設置 Test Control
blocks.en: Section 2: Test Controls

blocks.zh: L-929 細胞株 (L-929 Cell Line): 小鼠皮下結締組織成纖維細胞株，是 USP、ISO 10993-5 等標準共同指定的標準試驗細胞。ATCC CCL-1，具有穩定的增殖特性，對細胞毒性物質敏感性高。
blocks.en: L-929 Cell Line: A mouse subcutaneous connective tissue fibroblast cell line, and the standard test cell specified jointly by USP, ISO 10993-5 and other standards. ATCC CCL-1; it has stable proliferation characteristics and high sensitivity to cytotoxic substances.

blocks.zh: 陽性對照品 Positive Control (ZDEC/ZDBC): 含有二硫代氨基甲酸鋅的聚氨酯薄膜，必然引起細胞反應 ≥ Grade 3（中度）。用途：驗證試驗系統功能正常。
blocks.en: Positive Control (ZDEC/ZDBC): A polyurethane film containing zinc diethyldithiocarbamate that reliably causes a cell reaction of ≥ Grade 3 (Moderate). Purpose: to verify that the test system is functioning properly.

blocks.zh: 細胞培養關鍵參數：
blocks.en: Key cell culture parameters:

blocks.zh: 接種密度：約 10<sup>5</sup> cells/mL
blocks.en: Seeding density: about 10<sup>5</sup> cells/mL

blocks.zh: 培養條件：37 ± 1°C，5 ± 1% CO₂，加濕環境
blocks.en: Culture conditions: 37 ± 1°C, 5 ± 1% CO₂, humidified atmosphere

blocks.zh: 培養時間：NLT 24 h（至少24小時）
blocks.en: Incubation time: NLT 24 h (at least 24 hours)

blocks.zh: 匯合度要求：> 80% confluence（>80% 密合度）
blocks.en: Confluence requirement: > 80% confluence

blocks.zh: 試驗對照設置就像是測驗考場的「答案核驗」系統。陽性對照（ZDEC）就像是「故意放錯的題目」——你知道它必須出現毒性反應（≥ Grade 3），否則整個試驗系統就有問題；陰性對照（HDPE 或空白萃取液）就像「標準無毒答案」——必須顯示 Grade 0（無反應）。如果這兩個對照都不符合預期，整個批次試驗數據作廢，必須重做。
blocks.en: Setting up the test controls is like the "answer check" system of an exam. The positive control (ZDEC) is like a "deliberately wrong question": you know it must show a toxic reaction (≥ Grade 3), otherwise something is wrong with the whole test system. The negative control (HDPE or blank extractant) is like the "standard non-toxic answer" and must show Grade 0 (no reaction). If neither control meets expectations, the data for the whole test batch are invalid and the test must be repeated.

blocks.zh: 系統適合性判斷標準：
blocks.en: System suitability criteria:

blocks.zh: 陰性對照 → Grade 0（無反應）✓
blocks.en: Negative control → Grade 0 (no reaction) ✓

blocks.zh: 陽性對照 → 至少 Grade 3（中度） ✓
blocks.en: Positive control → at least Grade 3 (Moderate) ✓

blocks.zh: 兩者都必須同時成立，否則重新試驗
blocks.en: Both must be met at the same time; otherwise the test must be repeated

blocks.zh: 萃取溶劑選擇： 0.9% NaCl（等滲生理鹽水）是首選；若萃取溫度為 37°C/24h，則必須使用含血清培養液以防止蛋白質變性。
blocks.en: Extraction solvent selection: 0.9% NaCl (isotonic physiological saline) is the first choice; if the extraction is at 37°C/24 h, serum-supplemented culture medium must be used to prevent protein denaturation.

blocks.zh: 如果陽性對照只顯示 Grade 2，你的試驗批次結果是否有效？應如何處理？
blocks.en: If the positive control shows only Grade 2, is the result of your test batch valid? How should it be handled?

blocks.zh: L-929 細胞單層匯合度只有 65%，是否可以繼續進行試驗？
blocks.en: The L-929 cell monolayer is only 65% confluent. Can the test proceed?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 37°C 萃取時必須使用含血清培養液？
blocks.en: Why must serum-supplemented culture medium be used for extraction at 37°C?

blocks.zh: 第三節：儀器設備 Apparatus
blocks.en: Section 3: Apparatus

blocks.zh: Type I Glass (第一型玻璃): 硼矽酸鹽玻璃（Borosilicate Glass），化學惰性最高，不會向萃取液溶出可干擾試驗的成分。是 USP 生物試驗萃取容器的唯一指定材質。
blocks.en: Type I Glass: Borosilicate glass, which has the highest chemical inertness and does not release into the extractant any components that could interfere with the test. It is the only material specified by USP for extraction containers in biological tests.

blocks.zh: 三種萃取儀器對應三種溫度條件：
blocks.en: Three types of extraction equipment correspond to three temperature conditions:

blocks.zh: 高壓滅菌鍋（Autoclave）：121°C / 60 min（最嚴苛）
blocks.en: Autoclave: 121°C / 60 min (most severe)

blocks.zh: 烤箱（Oven）：70°C / 24 h 或 50°C / 72 h
blocks.en: Oven: 70°C / 24 h or 50°C / 72 h

blocks.zh: 培養箱（Incubator）：37°C / 24 h（最溫和，用於生理條件模擬）
blocks.en: Incubator: 37°C / 24 h (mildest, used to simulate physiological conditions)

blocks.zh: 萃取溫度越高，萃取越徹底，但越可能造成樣品物理變化（熔化/融合）。
blocks.en: The higher the extraction temperature, the more thorough the extraction, but the more likely the sample is to undergo physical changes (melting/fusing).

blocks.zh: 公式與規格 Specifications
blocks.en: Specifications

blocks.zh:
萃取條件對照：
高壓滅菌鍋：121 ± 2°C，60 min
烤箱（高溫）：70 ± 2°C，24 h
烤箱（中溫）：50 ± 2°C，72 h
培養箱：37 ± 1°C，24 h（含血清培養液）

萃取後冷卻：降至室溫，但不低於 20°C
萃取液保存：20°C–30°C，24 h 內使用
blocks.en:
Extraction conditions at a glance:
Autoclave: 121 ± 2°C, 60 min
Oven (high temperature): 70 ± 2°C, 24 h
Oven (medium temperature): 50 ± 2°C, 72 h
Incubator: 37 ± 1°C, 24 h (serum-supplemented culture medium)

Cooling after extraction: cool to room temperature, but not below 20°C
Extract storage: 20°C–30°C, use within 24 h

blocks.zh: 玻璃清潔的嚴格要求： 必須以鉻酸清潔液處理，必要時再用熱硝酸，最後用注射用無菌水沖洗。普通清潔劑殘留會干擾試驗結果。
blocks.en: Strict requirements for glass cleaning: Glassware must be treated with chromic acid cleaning solution and, where necessary, hot nitric acid, and finally rinsed with sterile water for injection. Residues of ordinary detergents can interfere with the test results.

blocks.zh: 環氧乙烷滅菌後 NLT 48 h 脫氣： EO 殘留本身具有細胞毒性，若脫氣不完全會導致假陽性結果。這在 CDMO 玻璃器皿管理中是常見的合規風險點。
blocks.en: Degassing for NLT 48 h after ethylene oxide sterilization: EO residues are themselves cytotoxic, and incomplete degassing leads to false-positive results. This is a common compliance risk point in glassware management at a CDMO.

blocks.zh: Polytef 惰性保護片： 螺蓋試管的彈性體內墊需用 50–75 µm 的 polytef（聚四氟乙烯）片完全覆蓋，防止彈性體成分干擾萃取結果。
blocks.en: Polytef protective disks: The elastomeric liner of a screw-capped tube must be completely covered with a 50–75 µm polytef (polytetrafluoroethylene) disk to prevent elastomer components from interfering with the extraction results.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 無菌充填線，橡膠塞（如 lyophilization stoppers）每批次使用前必須依 USP 〈87〉/〈88〉 進行材料認證。QC 實驗室在選擇萃取條件時，應根據容器的最終滅菌條件來選擇——若產品使用 121°C 高壓蒸汽滅菌，則萃取也應採用 121°C 條件，以模擬最惡劣的實際接觸情況。
blocks.en: On a CDMO aseptic filling line, rubber stoppers (such as lyophilization stoppers) must be qualified under USP <87>/<88> before each batch is used. When choosing extraction conditions, the QC laboratory should base them on the final sterilization conditions of the container: if the product is sterilized by 121°C steam autoclaving, the extraction should also use the 121°C condition, to simulate the worst-case actual contact.

blocks.zh: 第四節：瓊脂擴散試驗 Agar Diffusion Test
blocks.en: Section 4: Agar Diffusion Test

blocks.zh: 瓊脂層的雙重功能：
blocks.en: The dual function of the agar layer:

blocks.zh: 物理緩衝： 防止樣品直接壓迫細胞造成機械性損傷（非化學毒性）
blocks.en: Physical cushion: prevents the sample from pressing directly on the cells and causing mechanical damage (not chemical toxicity)

blocks.zh: 化學擴散： 可溶性毒性物質（leachables）仍可透過瓊脂向細胞擴散
blocks.en: Chemical diffusion: soluble toxic substances (leachables) can still diffuse through the agar to the cells

blocks.zh: 這讓試驗能區分「化學毒性」與「機械壓力」兩種不同傷害機制。
blocks.en: This allows the test to distinguish two different injury mechanisms: "chemical toxicity" and "mechanical pressure".

blocks.zh: 操作規格：
blocks.en: Test specifications:

blocks.zh: 培養皿：60 mm 直徑，7 mL 細胞懸液
blocks.en: Culture dish: 60 mm diameter, 7 mL of cell suspension

blocks.zh: 瓊脂濃度：NMT 2%（不超過2%）
blocks.en: Agar concentration: NMT 2% (not more than 2%)

blocks.zh: 每皿最多 3 個樣品
blocks.en: Maximum of 3 samples per dish

blocks.zh: 重複試驗：duplicate cultures（雙份）
blocks.en: Replicates: duplicate cultures

blocks.zh: 培養：NLT 24 h，37 ± 1°C，5 ± 1% CO₂
blocks.en: Incubation: NLT 24 h, 37 ± 1°C, 5 ± 1% CO₂

blocks.zh: 瓊脂擴散試驗就像在培養皿上鋪一層「保護果凍」。橡膠塞放在果凍上方，如果橡膠塞中有毒性物質（leachables），這些物質會慢慢滲透穿越果凍，到達下方的細胞層；果凍下方的細胞區域如果出現「死亡圈」，就代表毒性物質已經擴散過來了。死亡圈越大 → Grade 越高 → 毒性越強。
blocks.en: The Agar Diffusion Test is like laying a "protective jelly" over the culture dish. The rubber stopper sits on top of the jelly; if it contains toxic substances (leachables), these slowly seep through the jelly and reach the cell layer below. If a "zone of death" appears in the cell area under the jelly, the toxic substances have diffused through. The larger the zone, the higher the Grade and the stronger the toxicity.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Grading Criteria
blocks.en: Grading Criteria

blocks.zh:
Grade 0 (None):    無可偵測的反應區域 → 合格
Grade 1 (Slight):  樣品正下方有少量細胞變形 → 合格
Grade 2 (Mild):    反應區延伸 < 0.45 cm → 合格 (最大允許值)
Grade 3 (Moderate):反應區延伸 0.45–1.0 cm → 不合格
Grade 4 (Severe):  反應區延伸 > 1.0 cm → 不合格

合格標準：Sample ≤ Grade 2 (Mildly Reactive)
系統適合性：Negative Control = Grade 0
            Positive Control ≥ Grade 3
blocks.en:
Grade 0 (None):    no detectable reaction zone → pass
Grade 1 (Slight):  a few malformed cells directly under the sample → pass
Grade 2 (Mild):    reaction zone extends < 0.45 cm → pass (maximum allowed)
Grade 3 (Moderate):reaction zone extends 0.45–1.0 cm → fail
Grade 4 (Severe):  reaction zone extends > 1.0 cm → fail

Acceptance criterion: Sample ≤ Grade 2 (Mildly Reactive)
System suitability: Negative Control = Grade 0
            Positive Control ≥ Grade 3

blocks.zh: 瓊脂濃度的關鍵： 瓊脂必須能支撐細胞生長（品質合格），但又不能太厚（否則毒性物質無法擴散到細胞）。NMT 2% 是上限，實際操作通常使用 0.5–1.5%。
blocks.en: The key to agar concentration: The agar must support cell growth (acceptable quality) but must not be too thick (otherwise toxic substances cannot diffuse to the cells). NMT 2% is the upper limit; in practice 0.5–1.5% is usually used.

blocks.zh: 適用場景： 本試驗特別適合各種形狀的彈性體密封件（橡膠塞、隔膜、活塞等），因為瓊脂層可避免不規則形狀造成的機械損傷干擾。
blocks.en: Applicable situations: This test is particularly suitable for elastomeric closures of any shape (rubber stoppers, diaphragms, plungers, etc.), because the agar layer prevents mechanical damage caused by irregular shapes from interfering with the result.

blocks.zh: CDMO 藥廠採購新批次橡膠塞供應商時，QC 通常會先用瓊脂擴散試驗作為快速篩選工具。若結果 ≥ Grade 3，則立即退貨並通知採購部門；若 Grade 1–2，則視合規要求決定是否進行額外試驗。合格的試驗結果需保存於批次記錄，支持 DMF（藥物主文件）的容器密封系統章節。
blocks.en: When a CDMO pharmaceutical plant sources a new batch of rubber stoppers from a supplier, QC usually uses the Agar Diffusion Test first as a quick screening tool. If the result is ≥ Grade 3, the lot is rejected immediately and the purchasing department is notified; if it is Grade 1–2, whether to run additional tests depends on the compliance requirements. Acceptable test results should be kept in the batch records to support the container closure system section of the DMF (Drug Master File).

blocks.zh: 第五節：直接接觸試驗 Direct Contact Test
blocks.en: Section 5: Direct Contact Test

blocks.zh: 直接接觸試驗的特點：
blocks.en: Characteristics of the Direct Contact Test:

blocks.zh: 同步萃取與測試： 樣品直接放在細胞層上，萃取與毒性評估同時進行
blocks.en: Simultaneous extraction and testing: the sample is placed directly on the cell layer, so extraction and toxicity evaluation take place at the same time

blocks.zh: 無瓊脂保護層： 細胞直接暴露於樣品，敏感性較高
blocks.en: No agar protective layer: the cells are exposed directly to the sample, giving higher sensitivity

blocks.zh: 適用材料限制： 不適用於極低密度（浮起來壓不到細胞）或極高密度（壓壞細胞）的材料
blocks.en: Limits on applicable materials: not suitable for materials of very low density (they float and do not press on the cells) or very high density (they crush the cells)

blocks.zh: 操作規格差異（vs. 瓊脂擴散）：
blocks.en: Differences in test specifications (vs. Agar Diffusion):

blocks.zh: 培養皿：35 mm（vs. 60 mm）
blocks.en: Culture dish: 35 mm (vs. 60 mm)

blocks.zh: 細胞懸液：2 mL（vs. 7 mL）
blocks.en: Cell suspension: 2 mL (vs. 7 mL)

blocks.zh: 培養液量：0.8 mL fresh culture medium
blocks.en: Culture medium volume: 0.8 mL fresh culture medium

blocks.zh: 樣品：1 個/皿（vs. ≤3 個）
blocks.en: Samples: 1 per dish (vs. ≤ 3)

blocks.zh: 直接接觸試驗就是把材料樣品直接「貼在細胞臉上」。沒有果凍緩衝層，樣品和細胞零距離接觸。優點是反應更靈敏、更快速；缺點是如果樣品太重，可能會把細胞壓死——但這是「物理」傷害，不是「化學」毒性，需要區分。因此，直接接觸法不適合高密度（很重）或低密度（會漂走）的材料。
blocks.en: The Direct Contact Test places the material sample right "in the cells' face". With no jelly cushion, the sample and the cells are in zero-distance contact. The advantages are a more sensitive and faster reaction; the drawback is that a sample that is too heavy may crush the cells, but that is "physical" damage rather than "chemical" toxicity and must be distinguished from it. For this reason, the Direct Contact Test is not suitable for high-density (very heavy) or low-density (floating) materials.

blocks.zh: 判讀標準與瓊脂擴散試驗相同： 同樣使用 Table 1，合格標準同樣為 Sample ≤ Grade 2。差異在於試驗設置，不在判讀標準。
blocks.en: Interpretation criteria are the same as for the Agar Diffusion Test: Table 1 is used in the same way, and the acceptance criterion is again Sample ≤ Grade 2. The difference lies in the test setup, not in the interpretation criteria.

blocks.zh: 選擇時機： 適合外形不規則但具有平坦接觸面（≥ 100 mm²）、中等密度的材料，如部分注射器組件、軟性塑膠片材。
blocks.en: When to choose it: Suitable for materials of irregular shape that have a flat contact surface (≥ 100 mm²) and medium density, such as some syringe components and flexible plastic sheeting.

blocks.zh: 適用範圍限制： 不能用於：(1) 密度太低（如泡沫、多孔材料）；(2) 密度太高（如金屬組件）——改用溶出試驗。
blocks.en: Limits of applicability: It cannot be used for: (1) materials of too low density (such as foams and porous materials); (2) materials of too high density (such as metal components); use the Elution Test instead.

blocks.zh: 為什麼直接接觸試驗使用 35 mm 培養皿而非 60 mm？試想細胞密度的影響。
blocks.en: Why does the Direct Contact Test use a 35 mm culture dish rather than a 60 mm one? Consider the effect of cell density.

blocks.zh: 一個密度較高的 PETG 塑膠片材，應選用哪種試驗方法？原因為何？
blocks.en: Which test method should be chosen for a PETG plastic sheet of relatively high density, and why?

blocks.zh: 直接接觸試驗的樣品平坦面積要求（≥100 mm²）如何影響彈性體密封件的樣品制備？
blocks.en: How does the flat surface area requirement of the Direct Contact Test (≥ 100 mm²) affect sample preparation for elastomeric closures?

blocks.zh: 第六節：溶出試驗 Elution Test
blocks.en: Section 6: Elution Test

blocks.zh: 溶出試驗的核心差異：
blocks.en: The core difference of the Elution Test:

blocks.zh: 樣品材料不直接接觸細胞——只有萃取液（extract）接觸細胞
blocks.en: The sample material does not contact the cells directly; only the extract contacts the cells

blocks.zh: 最適合：高密度材料（無法用直接接觸法）、劑量反應研究
blocks.en: Best suited to: high-density materials (for which the Direct Contact Test cannot be used) and dose-response studies

blocks.zh: 培養時間：48 h（比其他兩種試驗的 24 h 更長）
blocks.en: Incubation time: 48 h (longer than the 24 h of the other two tests)

blocks.zh: 萃取液稀釋邏輯（重要！）：
blocks.en: Extract dilution logic (important!):

blocks.zh: 含血清培養液萃取 → 100% undiluted（不稀釋）
blocks.en: Extraction with serum-supplemented culture medium → 100% undiluted

blocks.zh: 無血清培養液萃取 → 100% undiluted（不稀釋）
blocks.en: Extraction with serum-free culture medium → 100% undiluted

blocks.zh: 0.9% NaCl 萃取 → 稀釋至 25%（用含血清培養液稀釋）
blocks.en: Extraction with 0.9% NaCl → diluted to 25% (diluted with serum-supplemented culture medium)

blocks.zh: NaCl 萃取液需稀釋，是因為純生理鹽水不含細胞生長所需的養分，直接使用 100% 濃度對細胞不利。
blocks.en: The NaCl extract must be diluted because plain saline contains none of the nutrients cells need to grow, so using it at 100% concentration is detrimental to the cells.

blocks.zh: 溶出試驗就像是「泡茶測試毒性」。你先把材料泡在特定溶劑裡（萃取），再把這杯「茶」加到細胞培養液中——細胞喝的是萃取液，不是直接咬材料。這讓你可以評估哪些物質「泡得出來」且具有毒性。NaCl 萃取液要稀釋的原因，就像過濃的鹽水環境本身就對細胞有害，需要稀釋到細胞可承受的濃度才能公平測試毒性物質的效應。
blocks.en: The Elution Test is like a "tea-brewing test for toxicity". You first soak the material in a specific solvent (extraction), then add this cup of "tea" to the cell culture medium: the cells drink the extract and do not bite the material directly. This lets you evaluate which substances can be "brewed out" and are toxic. The reason the NaCl extract is diluted is like a too-concentrated salt environment, which is itself harmful to cells; it must be diluted to a concentration the cells can tolerate so that the effect of toxic substances can be tested fairly.

blocks.zh: 溶出試驗評級標準 Elution Test Grading
blocks.en: Elution Test Grading

blocks.zh:
Grade 0 (None):    胞內顆粒完整，無細胞溶解 → 合格
Grade 1 (Slight):  ≤20% 細胞圓縮、鬆附、無胞內顆粒 → 合格
Grade 2 (Mild):    20–50% 細胞圓縮、無胞內顆粒 → 合格（上限）
Grade 3 (Moderate):50–70% 細胞層圓縮或溶解 → 不合格
Grade 4 (Severe):  細胞層幾乎完全破壞 → 不合格

合格：Sample ≤ Grade 2
注意：Table 2 評估的是細胞整體狀態（不同於 Table 1 的擴散區域）
blocks.en:
Grade 0 (None):    intracytoplasmic granules intact, no cell lysis → pass
Grade 1 (Slight):  ≤20% of cells rounded, loosely attached, without intracytoplasmic granules → pass
Grade 2 (Mild):    20–50% of cells rounded, without intracytoplasmic granules → pass (upper limit)
Grade 3 (Moderate):50–70% of the cell layer rounded or lysed → fail
Grade 4 (Severe):  cell layer almost completely destroyed → fail

Acceptance: Sample ≤ Grade 2
Note: Table 2 evaluates the overall state of the cells (unlike the diffusion zone of Table 1)

blocks.zh: Table 1 vs Table 2 的根本差異：
blocks.en: The fundamental difference between Table 1 and Table 2:

blocks.zh: Table 1（瓊脂擴散/直接接觸）：評估「空間擴散的毒性反應區域」大小
blocks.en: Table 1 (Agar Diffusion/Direct Contact): evaluates the size of the "zone of toxic reaction by spatial diffusion"

blocks.zh: Table 2（溶出試驗）：評估「整體細胞存活率」與細胞形態學變化
blocks.en: Table 2 (Elution Test): evaluates "overall cell viability" and changes in cell morphology

blocks.zh: 劑量反應研究（Dose-Response）： 若需確認毒性物質濃度與反應關係，可使用定量稀釋系列（如 100%, 50%, 25%, 12.5%...）重複試驗，建立劑量反應曲線。這在毒理學評估中具有重要價值。
blocks.en: Dose-Response Study: To confirm the relationship between the concentration of a toxic substance and the reaction, the test can be repeated with a quantitative dilution series (such as 100%, 50%, 25%, 12.5%...) to build a dose-response curve. This is of great value in toxicological assessment.

blocks.zh: 培養時間 48 h： 比其他試驗多 24 h，讓亞急性毒性（subacute toxicity）效應有足夠時間顯現。
blocks.en: 48 h incubation time: 24 h longer than the other tests, giving subacute toxicity effects enough time to appear.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的包裝材料驗證（Container Closure System Validation）中，IV 袋（高密度 PP/PE 材質）通常使用溶出試驗進行 USP 〈87〉 評估。萃取溶劑的選擇會參考藥品的最終劑型——水性製劑選 NaCl/培養液；油性製劑（如脂肪乳劑）則需要在 USP 〈88〉 階段才用植物油萃取。
blocks.en: In CDMO packaging material validation (Container Closure System Validation), IV bags (high-density PP/PE) are usually evaluated under USP <87> by the Elution Test. The choice of extraction solvent takes into account the final dosage form of the drug product: for aqueous preparations, NaCl/culture medium is chosen; for oily preparations (such as fat emulsions), extraction with vegetable oil is needed only at the USP <88> stage.

blocks.zh: 第七節：三種試驗方法比較 Comparison of Three Test Methods
blocks.en: Section 7: Comparison of the Three Test Methods

blocks.zh: 三種試驗方法總覽 Summary Overview
blocks.en: Summary Overview

blocks.zh: 選擇試驗方法的決策樹
blocks.en: Decision tree for choosing a test method

blocks.zh: 彈性體密封件（橡膠塞、隔膜） → 優先選瓊脂擴散試驗
blocks.en: Elastomeric closures (rubber stoppers, diaphragms) → choose the Agar Diffusion Test first

blocks.zh: 中密度塑膠片材、組件 → 直接接觸試驗
blocks.en: Medium-density plastic sheeting and components → Direct Contact Test

blocks.zh: 高密度材料 / 需劑量反應數據 → 溶出試驗
blocks.en: High-density materials / need for dose-response data → Elution Test

blocks.zh: 法規要求指定特定方法 → 依法規執行
blocks.en: Regulation requires a specific method → follow the regulation

blocks.zh: 注意： 可以同時進行多種試驗，但法規文件中必須說明選擇理由（科學合理性）。
blocks.en: Note: Several tests can be run at the same time, but the regulatory documentation must state the reason for the choice (scientific justification).

blocks.zh: 三種試驗的核心共同點：
blocks.en: Core common points of the three tests:

blocks.zh: 同樣使用 L-929 細胞
blocks.en: The same L-929 cells are used

blocks.zh: 同樣需要系統適合性確認（陰/陽性對照）
blocks.en: The same system suitability check is required (negative/positive controls)

blocks.zh: 同樣的合格標準：Sample ≤ Grade 2
blocks.en: The same acceptance criterion: Sample ≤ Grade 2

blocks.zh: 同樣的結論：不合格者 → 進入 USP 〈88〉
blocks.en: The same conclusion: failure → proceed to USP <88>

blocks.zh: 一個 lyophilization stopper（冷凍乾燥用橡膠塞）應優先選擇哪種試驗？若客戶要求劑量反應數據，應追加哪種試驗？
blocks.en: Which test should be chosen first for a lyophilization stopper? If the customer requires dose-response data, which additional test should be added?

blocks.zh: 直接接觸試驗 vs. 溶出試驗，哪一種對揮發性毒性物質更敏感？為什麼？
blocks.en: Direct Contact Test vs. Elution Test: which is more sensitive to volatile toxic substances, and why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼三種試驗的合格標準統一為 Grade ≤ 2，而不是 Grade ≤ 1？
blocks.en: Why is the acceptance criterion for all three tests set uniformly at Grade ≤ 2 rather than Grade ≤ 1?

blocks.zh: 第八節：附加要求 Additional Requirements
blocks.en: Section 8: Additional Requirements

blocks.zh: USP High-Density Polyethylene RS（高密度聚乙烯參考標準品）：
blocks.en: USP High-Density Polyethylene RS (high-density polyethylene reference standard):

blocks.zh: 這是 USP 官方認證的陰性對照材料。HDPE（高密度聚乙烯）是公認的生物相容性良好的塑膠材料，不含任何已知細胞毒性物質。在試驗中扮演「應顯示 Grade 0 反應」的陰性對照。
blocks.en: This is the officially certified USP negative control material. HDPE (high-density polyethylene) is a plastic widely recognized as having good biocompatibility and contains no known cytotoxic substances. In the test it serves as the negative control that "should show a Grade 0 reaction".

blocks.zh: 相關 ASTM 標準：
blocks.en: Related ASTM standards:

blocks.zh: ASTM F 895-84：瓊脂擴散細胞培養細胞毒性篩選標準試驗方法
blocks.en: ASTM F 895-84: Standard Test Method for Agar Diffusion Cell Culture Screening for Cytotoxicity

blocks.zh: ASTM F 813-83：醫療器材直接接觸細胞培養評估標準實踐
blocks.en: ASTM F 813-83: Standard Practice for Direct Contact Cell Culture Evaluation of Materials for Medical Devices

blocks.zh: ZDEC/ZDBC 陽性對照來源： 由日本神奈川縣的食品藥物安全中心（Hatano Research Institute）提供。在實際試驗中，必須使用有效期限內、來自認可來源的陽性對照材料，並保留 COA（Certificate of Analysis）。
blocks.en: Source of the ZDEC/ZDBC positive controls: Supplied by the Hatano Research Institute, the food and drug safety center in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. In actual testing, positive control material that is within its expiry date and from an approved source must be used, and the COA (Certificate of Analysis) must be kept.

blocks.zh: USP 參考標準品的採購管理： 所有 USP RS（Reference Standards）必須從 USP 官方採購，並依儲存條件管理，確保追溯性。這是 GMP 實驗室 QA 管控的重點項目。
blocks.en: Procurement control of USP reference standards: All USP RS (Reference Standards) must be purchased from USP and managed according to their storage conditions to ensure traceability. This is a key item in QA control of a GMP laboratory.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 QC 實驗室在執行 USP 〈87〉 試驗時，必須建立以下管理程序：(1) USP HDPE RS 的接收、庫存、使用記錄；(2) ZDEC/ZDBC 陽性對照的有效期追蹤；(3) L-929 細胞株的傳代代數管理（通常限制在一定代數內以確保試驗重現性）。這些都是 FDA/EMEA 查廠時的重點稽核項目。
blocks.en: When a CDMO QC laboratory performs USP <87> tests, it must establish the following control procedures: (1) receipt, inventory and usage records for USP HDPE RS; (2) expiry tracking for the ZDEC/ZDBC positive controls; (3) passage number management of the L-929 cell line (usually limited to a certain passage number to ensure test reproducibility). These are all key audit items during FDA/EMEA inspections.

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 目的： USP 〈87〉 測定彈性體、塑膠等高分子材料的體外生物反應性，使用哺乳動物細胞培養系統
blocks.en: Purpose: USP <87> determines the in vitro biological reactivity of elastomers, plastics and other polymeric materials using mammalian cell culture systems

blocks.zh: 三種試驗： 瓊脂擴散試驗（彈性體首選）、直接接觸試驗（中密度材料）、溶出試驗（高密度材料/劑量反應）
blocks.en: Three tests: Agar Diffusion Test (first choice for elastomers), Direct Contact Test (medium-density materials), Elution Test (high-density materials/dose-response)

blocks.zh: 試驗細胞： L-929 小鼠成纖維細胞株（ATCC CCL-1），>80% 匯合度
blocks.en: Test cells: L-929 mouse fibroblast cell line (ATCC CCL-1), >80% confluence

blocks.zh: 系統適合性： 陰性對照 = Grade 0；陽性對照 ≥ Grade 3；否則試驗無效
blocks.en: System suitability: negative control = Grade 0; positive control ≥ Grade 3; otherwise the test is invalid

blocks.zh: 合格標準： 三種試驗統一 → Sample ≤ Grade 2（輕度反應）
blocks.en: Acceptance criterion: uniform for all three tests → Sample ≤ Grade 2 (Mildly Reactive)

blocks.zh: 評級量表： Table 1（0–4 空間擴散評估）用於瓊脂擴散和直接接觸；Table 2（0–4 細胞存活評估）用於溶出試驗
blocks.en: Grading scales: Table 1 (0–4, spatial diffusion evaluation) is used for Agar Diffusion and Direct Contact; Table 2 (0–4, cell viability evaluation) is used for the Elution Test

blocks.zh: 上下游關係： 〈87〉 不合格 → 必須進行 〈88〉 動物試驗；〈87〉 是第一道材料安全篩選關卡
blocks.en: Upstream/downstream relationship: failing <87> → USP <88> animal testing is required; <87> is the first material safety screening gate

blocks.zh: 萃取條件： NaCl 注射液（首選）、含/無血清培養液；溫度：37°C（生理）→ 50°C → 70°C → 121°C（漸增嚴苛度）
blocks.en: Extraction conditions: NaCl injection (first choice), serum-supplemented/serum-free culture medium; temperature: 37°C (physiological) → 50°C → 70°C → 121°C (increasing severity)

blocks.zh: CDMO 業務意義： 新供應商材料認定、批次放行測試、藥品申請 DMF 的容器密封系統生物相容性數據支撐
blocks.en: CDMO business significance: qualification of new supplier materials, batch release testing, and biocompatibility data supporting the container closure system section of a DMF for drug product applications
